follows: develop_logs/notes/20261031_m0_v1_v5_report.md (V2 scheduled for idle GPUs); 20261024 CHOIS matrix: guidance lowers 0.1 s jerk by 3.75 [-4.81, -2.69] (12 windows x 5 seeds)
question: Why does CHOIS geometric guidance lower jerk: the feet-floor term, the hand-object term, any late gradient (low-pass), or slower motion content
hypothesis: The jerk drop comes from the feet-floor contact term suppressing foot jitter and is unrelated to the hand-object term

competing_explanations.a_feet_floor: feet-floor term suppresses high-frequency foot jitter
competing_explanations.b_any_gradient: any gradient applied in the last steps acts as a low-pass filter
competing_explanations.c_content: the hand-object term changes the motion content (slower, smaller)

tasks: First two eligible full native windows (text annotation present, >= 120 frames, start index 0) of each of the 13 test objects in native index order; G = 26. The first window of the first 12 objects is the 20261024 matrix task set. Fixed before outcomes
cluster_unit: task (G = 26); seeds are paired repetitions within a task; object-clustered intervals (13 clusters) reported as sensitivity

G.role: native guidance through the instrumented loss (bit identity with the 20261024 native function checked in the pilot)

HO.role: hand-object term only (1e4 x native loss)

FF.role: feet-floor term only (3e5 x native loss)

RND.role: Gaussian direction on the support of the native gradient with the same norm at every guided step

grid: 8 arms x 26 tasks x 3 seeds = 624 runs, all new (the 20261024 runs are only the bit-identity reference)

metrics.foot_jerk_0p1s: common-step (0.1 s) jerk RMS over left/right ankle and foot joints
metrics.jerk_0p1s: common-step jerk RMS over all 24 joints (the 20261024 effect)
metrics.mean_joint_speed_m_s: mean joint speed over frames and joints (content explanation c)
metrics.official: CHOIS evaluation_metrics json: foot sliding, floor height, contact percent, hand / human-object penetration, waypoint xy error, start / end object position error

primary.endpoint: foot_jerk_0p1s, FF - N0; cluster t interval (task clusters) and exact sign-flip p
primary.stop_rule: FF - N0 excludes 0 and HO - N0 includes 0: (a) confirmed, the guidance jerk claim is rewritten as 'the feet-floor contact term lowers jerk'. Both exclude 0: interaction analysis G - HO - FF + N0. Neither excludes 0: the guidance jerk claim is downgraded. Only HO - N0 excludes 0: (a) rejected, hand-object term carries the effect

secondary: replication: G - N0 on jerk_0p1s and foot_jerk_0p1s
low-pass (b): RND - N0 and RND - G on foot_jerk_0p1s
content (c): HO - N0 and G - N0 on mean_joint_speed_m_s
dose: S05, G, S2 and W49 against N0 and G
each arm against N0 on official foot sliding, floor height, contact percent, penetration, object errors and contact distance; Holm within this family
per-step guidance diagnostics: loss values and gradient norms of each term, applied perturbation scale

inference.primary: Equal-weight task means of paired differences; cluster t interval with G-1 degrees of freedom and exact sign-flip p
inference.supplementary: Cluster bootstrap alongside, never as the decision interval
inference.multiplicity: One primary endpoint; Holm over the secondary per-arm family

pilot.jobs: Task 1, seed 21, every arm (8 jobs) plus a development check: native loss x 0 through the instrumented path (not analyzed)
pilot.admission: Finite complete outputs; official metrics json present; time within 3x estimate; guidance calls = last_step - 1 for guided arms and 0 for N0; N0 and G bit-identical to the 20261024 runs chois_task1_seed21_guidance0 / guidance1; the x 0 check bit-identical to N0 (otherwise the guided path itself changes the output and this is reported); HO and FF differ from G; RND direction norm equals the native gradient norm within 1e-4 relative at every guided step; at the first guided step (t = 9, identical state) every guided arm records the same term losses as G

conventions_not_derived.tasks: two windows per object to reach G >= 24 as required by the 20261031 V5 review
conventions_not_derived.random_direction: Gaussian on the support of the native gradient, rescaled to its norm at every step; generator seeded with the run seed, independent of the sampling noise
conventions_not_derived.foot_joints: ankle and foot joints of the 24-joint CHOIS skeleton
